entities.name: Aboshan Trench
entities.description: An area of the Mer Empire that formerly was part of continental Otaria, sunk beneath the sea by Emperor Aboshan.

entities.name: Emperor Aboshan
entities.description: Mer emperor who found the Mirari, sank part of Otaria and withered and died from its power.

entities.name: Llawan
entities.description: Aboshan's widow, who named the trench and trapped Laquatus.

entities.name: Laquatus
entities.description: Llawan's scheming enemy, lured into the Otaria Chasm.

entities.name: Rillu Veza
entities.description: Llawan's advisor who surveyed the land and planted portal crystals.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: An immensely powerful artifact found by Aboshan that drew on its wielder's essence.

entities.name: Mer Empire
entities.description: The undersea empire that claimed the trench.

entities.name: Otaria Chasm
entities.description: A feature of the trench used in Llawan's trap for Laquatus.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: The continent that formerly included the trench.

entities.name: Krosa
entities.description: A forest region where Laquatus escaped and fell.

entities.name: Borben
entities.description: A coastal town that was part of the lost land.

entities.name: Battle for the Mirari
entities.description: The 4305 AR event during which Aboshan found the Mirari.

events.summary: During the Battle for the Mirari in 4305 AR, Emperor Aboshan finds the Mirari buried in silt in an imperial treasury.
events.quote: the Mirari was found by Emperor Aboshan , buried in silt in the lower levels of an imperial treasury

events.summary: Aboshan uses the Mirari to raise giant waves that claim a stretch of Otaria's coast.
events.quote: creating giant crashing waves that claimed the stretch of coast that later would be named the Aboshan Trench

events.summary: The Mirari draws on Aboshan's essence and he withers and dies, ending the spell.
events.quote: the spell quickly caused Aboshan to wither away and die

events.summary: Llawan has Rillu Veza plant portal crystals in the Otaria Chasm as a trap for Laquatus.
events.quote: who had her advisor Rillu Veza survey the new Mer land and plant portal crystals in the Otaria Chasm

events.summary: Laquatus is lured by a false map into the Otaria Chasm and trapped; he escapes into Krosa but his army is wiped out by Llawan.
events.quote: his army was wiped out by Llawan in the meantime, leading to Laquatus's downfall in the forest

relations.note: Her scheming enemy, whom she trapped.
